meta.source: 24 deterministic synthetic histories; 8 scenarios x 50/200/1000 turns; no external model requests
meta.tokenCounter: ceil(UTF-16 characters/4), explicit role/tool/unknown-part rendering; estimates, not tokenizer/provider usage
meta.providerUsage: No model called; input is replayed model-visible boundary; output and provider cache are unmeasured (null)
meta.sampling: 4 equally spaced complete-turn prefixes, two actual transform calls per prefix for both strategies, including pre-plan calls. Query and first-hit source expansion add full-context follow-up inputs. Not a call per historical turn. First compression timeout aborts the remaining calls of that group and marks the row incomplete; incomplete rows never enter savings comparisons.
meta.cache: unchangedPrefixTokens is byte-identical-prefix UTF-16/4 opportunity only, not a provider cache hit or discount; analysisCacheHits is daemon reuse
meta.telemetry: ps time/RSS sampled after compress and final retrieval, CPU includes daemon startup; RSS is sampled peak, not OS high-water mark. Layered queue/service/operation counters from actual RPC; legacy internal counters unavailable=null. Separate fresh daemon per case/group.
meta.sourceRecovery: Exact original-message hash pagination is validation-only and excluded from model-input totals. 2/5/20 checkpoints are consecutive raw-host planning generations, not recursive tree depth. Final source/memory component estimates omit framing and need not sum to total.
meta.baseline: 62589ac frozen baseline untouched; strategies are compared using current production runtime with identical settings
